name: Santa María del Cubillo (Spain)
description: Divided horizontally by an indented line into two equal parts, blue above with a white twelve-pointed star and red below.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 15 April 2003 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 93 of 23 May 2003); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, divided horizontally into two equal parts by a line indented of two indents, the upper blue with a white twelve-pointed star at the centre and the lower red.
